column1: # The pointer symbols of WordNet's adverbs (wninput(5WN), "The pointer_symbols for adverbs are"): the symbols shared with
# the other categories mean what they mean there; "\" in an adverb is "Derived from adjective". The database holds two
# more than that page lists for adverbs: data.adv has one "+" (practicably, of practicable), which wnsearch(3WN) gives
# one meaning in every category, and index.adv writes an adverb's domain pointers without their kind, as ";".
